guard/30380.htm.text: Guard Plink: Guard Plink on duty, all clear! Finished patrolling the harbor and standing sentry at the village west gate! If you find anyone misbehaving or acting suspicious, don t hesitate to alert the guards. Guards are your friends!

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30380-1.htm.text: Guard Plink: The harbor, directions to! To go to the harbor, go straight in the direction I am looking. For passage on a boat, see Clancy, the Wharf Manager . You can buy your tickets from him.

guard/30380-2.htm.text: Guard Plink: Clancy? Wharf Manager Clancy, in charge of the harbor of Gludin. If you want passage by boat to Talking Island, you may buy a ticket from him!

links.text: "Hey, you! Don't you think you talk too stiffly?"

guard/30380-3.htm.text: Guard Plink: I'm sorry! I cannot answer questions I don't understand.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
